test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word given in brackets to fill in the blank.

A _______________(distinct) sense of restlessness was bothering me when I left the cemetery.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"distinct"** means something that is clearly defined, unmistakable, or easily perceivable. (स्पष्ट)

 
 
• **Example: **The distinct aroma of fresh coffee filled the room.
 
 
 
• **"Vague"** refers to something that is unclear, indefinite, or not clearly expressed. (अस्पष्ट)
 
 
• **Example: **Her memories of the event were vague and incomplete.
 
 

Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'distinct'** is **'vague'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Terrible** (भयानक): Extremely bad or serious.

 
 
• **Example:** The weather was **terrible,** with heavy rain and strong winds.
 
 
 
• **Critical** (महत्वपूर्ण): Expressing adverse or disapproving comments or judgments.
 
 
• **Example:** The situation is** critical** and needs immediate attention.
 
 
 
• **Prior** (पूर्व): Existing or coming before in time, order, or importance.
 
 
• **Example:** She had a **prior** engagement and couldn't attend the meeting.
